thread:
oliver_pm: Quick async check — Friday milestone for Optimize toolkit drop (quant recs + batching/caching suggestions). Can each owner post status, known blockers, and any regression alerts. I want a short plan for rollback/fallback if we hit quality regressions. @tara_platform to start?

tara_platform: On it. High level: packaging + docs done. Integration tests running. Owners: quant recs -> kevin_ml, batching/caching -> maria_dev, rollout config -> me. Blockers: one perf weirdness on 4k seqs, and a failing eval for a paraphrase prompt set.

kevin_ml: Quant team status: finalizing FP16/8 configs and per-model profiles. Baseline perf looks good except for the t5-like model where generated truncation increases with 8-bit on long prompts. Root cause suspected: KV cache indexing in our quant runtime. Repro snippet (local):

```
python -m optimize.run --model t5-large --quant 8 --seq 4096 --prompt-file tests/long_prompts.txt
# observe truncated outputs after ~2.8k tokens
```

I opened PR #4523 with a patch to KV index math, awaiting review. CI shows flaky test on macos only.

maria_dev: Batching/caching updates: default batcher config v2 staged, cache key scheme updated to include prompt hash + model-vendor-id. Local benchmarks: 18% token/s improvement on small chats, 6% on long-form. Blocker: need approval for cache TTL change (could increase memory by ~12%). Also found an interaction where cache hits + 8-bit quant cause slightly different tokenization boundaries -> appears as small semantic diffs in evals. Filing an eval alert now.

sam_sre: Saw the regression alert in the eval dashboard (paraphrase set). It flagged quality drop ~4% on BLEU and a few hallucination cases. Rollout options: can gate quantized models under canary 5% traffic or fallback to FP16 on anomaly detection. We should decide which today.

oliver_pm: Key decisions needed: 1) canary percentage, 2) whether to hold quantized t5 variant until KV fix lands, 3) cache TTL. Quick proposals: 1) canary 5% for 48h, auto-roll back on eval delta >3% or >1% hallucinations; 2) hold t5-8bit; 3) set TTL to 12h and monitor mem delta. Thoughts?

kevin_ml: Agree to hold t5-8bit until PR reviewed + CI green. Canary 5% sounds safe. Also proposing a regression-monitoring job to run the paraphrase eval every hour during canary. I can wire it to the regression-alert webhook.

maria_dev: TTL 12h OK. I'll add mem/eviction dashboards to console and tag @sam_sre for alert thresholds. For the cache+quant tokenization diffs, I'll add a normalization step in cache key generation to reduce boundary sensitivity. Shouldn't be visible to end users.

ci-bot: New CI run for PR #4523 started (linux/gpu: queued). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/98765 :eyes:

oliver_pm: Next actions: kevin -> get PR review + green CI before EOD; maria -> implement normalization + create mem dashboards; sam -> prepare canary config (5%, 48h) and rollback policy; tara -> update release notes and runbook with fallback steps. If PR not green by EOD, we hold the t5 quant variant and proceed with other models.

maria_dev: I'll ping infra to get extra mem quota for staging cache TTL test. ETA ~3pm PT.

kevin_ml: Noted, I'll ping @lia_ml for a quick review and try to re-run CI on the macos job.

sam_sre: Canary config drafted, pushing to staging now. Will attach the eval webhook and set auto rollback on delta >=3%.

oliver_pm: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers, drop short updates here. Would like a ✅ by 6pm PT or we'll postpone t5-8bit until next week. :shipit:
